statement.zh: 第四千纪「乌鲁克扩张」可作为讨论南部两河与周边地区物质文化联系的学术模型（Algaze 等）；其性质（殖民/仿效/贸易/多因互动）仍有修订与批评空间。
statement.en: The 4th-millennium ‘Uruk expansion’ is a scholarly model for southern Mesopotamian interaction with surrounding regions (Algaze et al.); character (colony / emulation / trade / multi-causal) remains open to revision/critique.

disclaimer: This record is a HYPOTHESIS / scholarly model label, not an established historical or archaeological conclusion. Do not treat as fact.

editorial.notes: Statements paraphrased from cited sections of civ-mesopotamia.md only.
